**Discpress 1.1.1 gets you converting sooner.** You no longer have to wait for the game check to finish before a conversion starts, the check itself is twice as fast, and starting a conversion straight away now always uses the right name and disc type.

## Download

**[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.1.1/discpress.html)** (about 2.5 MB). The whole app in one file that works offline. To update, download it and use it instead of your old copy.

## What's new

### Start converting right away

When you add a full disc image, Discpress reads its checksum to confirm the exact release in the Redump database. On a big image that took a while, and the conversion waited for it: several seconds for a PlayStation disc, and around half a minute or more for a PlayStation 2 DVD.

Now the conversion can start as soon as Discpress knows which game it is. The checksum keeps running alongside (you'll see its progress under the game's name), and if it finds a more exact match, for example a specific revision, the finished file is renamed to match. If you've already saved the file, or typed your own name, Discpress leaves the name alone. When results are saved straight into a folder, Discpress still waits for the checksum, because those files are named as they're written.

### A faster game check

The checksum now runs about twice as fast. On a 700 MB PlayStation disc it takes about 1.5 seconds instead of 3.5 on a typical computer.

### Fixes

- If you pressed **Create CHD** while the card still said "Identifying game…", the result kept the file's own name instead of the game's title. It now waits the moment it takes to recognize the game and uses the right name.
- In the same situation, a PlayStation game stored as an `.iso` could be converted as a DVD CHD instead of a CD CHD. It is now always converted as a CD.

## Same files as desktop chdman

Your CHDs are still exactly the same, byte for byte, as the ones desktop chdman 0.289 makes. Every change in this release was checked against it with the automated test suite.
